title: Graded retry suppressor and degradation fallback for hosted timeout waves

acceptance_criteria: Canary edge suppressor reduces per-tenant retry amplification by >= 70% compared to baseline
Runtime p99 stall time reduced by >= 25% after KV incremental compaction
Model-variant fallback reduces end-to-end timeout rate by >= 50% for canary tenants under synthetic surge
No regression in correctness for model outputs (automated eval pass) and no >2% increase in 95th latency outside controlled canary
Runbook updated and oncall drill completed with SRE signoff
